msg_index_rebuilt_with_warning: Index rebuild completed with warnings: {failed} terms failed ({success}/{total} succeeded). See the log for details.
msg_index_cleared_empty_glossary: Glossary is empty, so the existing vector index was cleared.
msg_no_valid_terms: No valid terms found in CSV.
msg_starting_translation: Starting translation for {total} items with {threads} threads.
msg_duplicate_optimization: Duplicate content optimization: {total} total items, {unique} unique, saved {saved} API calls.
msg_row_not_translated: The selected row has not been translated yet.
tooltip_param_temperature: When enabled, send temperature to the model. Lower values are more stable; higher values are more creative.
tooltip_param_top_p: When enabled, send top_p nucleus sampling to the model. Usually leave disabled unless your provider requires it.
tooltip_param_enable_thinking: When enabled, explicitly sends the provider-specific thinking switch. Only use with compatible models.
tooltip_param_reasoning_effort: When enabled, sends reasoning_effort parameter. Only effective when Thinking is on. low/medium map to high, xhigh maps to max.
group_search_llm_settings: Search Model Settings (Optional - for keyword extraction)
group_search_fallback_llm_settings: Search Fallback Model Settings (Optional - for keyword extraction failover)
tooltip_embed_dim: Set Embedding model vector dimensions (e.g. 1536 for OpenAI)
tooltip_trans_threads: Number of concurrent translation requests. Increase carefully to avoid rate limits or higher memory use.
tooltip_vec_threads: Number of concurrent embedding/vectorization requests used when importing terms or rebuilding the vector index.
tooltip_short_text_batch_enabled: Optional: combine several short translation items into one LLM request. Falls back to single-item translation on errors.
tooltip_short_text_batch_max_chars: Only texts at or below this character count are eligible for batching.
tooltip_short_text_batch_size: Maximum number of short texts sent in one LLM request.
tooltip_rag_threshold: Minimum similarity required for glossary matches. Higher values are stricter; lower values recall more but may add noise.
tooltip_rag_short_max_results: Maximum number of short-term glossary entries returned per RAG retrieval.
tooltip_rag_long_max_results: Maximum number of long-term glossary entries returned per RAG retrieval.
tooltip_log_level: Minimum log level shown and written. DEBUG is most verbose; ERROR only records failures.
tooltip_language: Changes the application interface language. Restart may be required for all text to update.
tooltip_color_mode: Switch application appearance between system auto, light, and dark modes.
tooltip_source_language: Language of the source text. Auto-detect usually works for mixed or unknown files.
tooltip_target_language: Language to translate into. This is injected into prompts and affects model output.
tooltip_mcm_output_suffix: Controls the language suffix used when saving MCM text files, for example _CHINESE or keeping the source suffix.
label_mcm_auto_export: Auto-export MCM to source folder after translation
tooltip_mcm_auto_export: When enabled, translated MCM text files are saved automatically after translation finishes.
label_task_completion_sound: Play a sound when tasks finish
tooltip_task_completion_sound: When enabled, play the system notification sound after translation or glossary tasks finish.
tooltip_prompt_style: Select prompt style: 'default' for standard localization, 'nsfw' for explicit content (no censorship), 'lore_accurate' for maximum lore fidelity, 'modern_colloquial' for natural everyday speech, 'erotic_novel' for literary adult fiction quality.
msg_failed_load_mcm: Failed to load MCM text file.
msg_raw_plugin_not_supported: Raw plugin files ({ext}) are not supported. Export them to XML in xTranslator or ESP-ESM Translator first, then open the exported XML.
msg_unsupported_translation_file: Unsupported file type: {ext}. Only XML translation files (*.xml) and MCM text files (*.txt) are supported.
msg_empty_source_dest: Source and Dest cannot be empty.
msg_confirm_delete_terms: Are you sure you want to delete {count} terms?
msg_glossary_task_completed_with_warning: Glossary task completed with warnings. See the log for details.
msg_glossary_task_failed: Glossary task failed. See the log for details.
msg_confirm_clear_all: Clear all translations? This action cannot be undone.
msg_embedding_config_changed_rebuild_req: Embedding settings changed. The current vector index is now stale. Click Rebuild/Update Vector Index to rebuild it.
msg_vector_index_mismatch_prompt:
The vector index was built with a different Embedding model than your current settings. Vector search will be skipped.

Index model: {stored_model} ({stored_url})
Current model: {current_model} ({current_url})

Rebuild the index now?
Choosing "No" will continue translation with glossary-only matching.
msg_vector_index_mismatch_continue: Vector index model mismatch. Translation continues in degraded mode (glossary-only). Please rebuild the index later.
msg_invalid_base_url: Invalid URL in {group} / {field}. Use a full http:// or https:// URL.
msg_restart_for_language: Restart the application to apply the new language setting.
label_rag_recall_limit_note: Recall count is controlled only by short/long glossary max results.
tooltip_rag_keyword_max_queries: Maximum number of keyword search tasks per entry. Prevents unexpectedly large recall workloads.
tooltip_rag_keyword_task_decompose_enabl: Split longer source text into smaller keyword tasks to improve glossary recall.
tooltip_rag_keyword_task_keep_original: Also search with the full original phrase after decomposition. May improve recall but can add duplicate candidates.
tooltip_rag_short_term_max_chars: Character-length threshold for short-term bucket; entries with length <= this value are treated as short-term.
label_rag_ai_path_disabled_note: AI candidate path is disabled in this version and will be replaced by reranker.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_enabled: Boost candidates that match important keywords before selecting glossary references.
tooltip_rag_min_vector_score: Minimum vector similarity before a candidate can enter keyword-weighted selection.
tooltip_rag_expert_params: Show advanced keyword-weighting knobs. Leave hidden unless tuning RAG behavior.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_candidate_poo: Number of semantic candidates considered before keyword weighting.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_keep_k: Maximum number of weighted candidates kept after reranking.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_min_primary_h: Minimum primary keyword matches to prefer before fallback candidates are used.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_exact_boost: Score bonus for exact keyword matches.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_contains_boos: Score bonus when a candidate contains a keyword as part of a longer phrase.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_token_boost: Score bonus for token-level keyword overlap.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_anchor_max_df: Maximum document frequency for a token to be treated as a useful anchor. Lower values favor rarer terms.
tooltip_rag_keyword_weight_anchor_boost: Score bonus for matching rare anchor tokens.
msg_confirm_reset_rag_advanced: Reset all RAG advanced settings to default values?
msg_rag_advanced_reset_done: RAG advanced settings were reset. Click Save Config to persist.
